An agent chains the steps a function does today, with the three models sharing the work

FunctionAgentWhat it does from start to finishSmallVisionLargeWho approves
ResearchEarnings-season agentCollects the filing and transcript when results come out, pulls the tables, updates the draft noteAnalyst
Fund managementMorning-brief agentWatches overnight news on holdings, checks scheme limits, prepares the briefFund manager
OperationsOnboarding agentReads the form and proofs, checks KYC, asks the investor for what is missingOperations staff
Risk and complianceCircular agentSpots a new circular, splits it into obligations, maps them to policies, opens tasksCompliance officer
SalesDistributor-desk agentAnswers the query from approved documents, logs it, schedules the follow-upRelationship manager
MarketingFactsheet agentPulls portfolio data, drafts commentary, translates it, runs the code checkCompliance
Investor serviceService agentTags the request, reads any attachment, fetches folio status, drafts the replyService agent

The pattern repeats: a small model handles the volume, a vision model reads documents where there are any, a large model plans and drafts, and a named person approves.

Illustrative designs; the model mix follows the function slides before this one
